licenseUI.edition.BASIC.label: Basic
licenseUI.edition.ADVANCED.label: Advanced
licenseUI.edition.ENTERPRISE.label: Enterprise
licenseUI.feature.BASIC_ROUTING.name: Basic routing
licenseUI.feature.BASIC_ROUTING.desc: Path matching, rewriting and forwarding essentials
licenseUI.feature.BASIC_ROUTING.detail: Basic routing is the core of the gateway: it matches routes by path, request method, headers and more, and supports path rewriting and request forwarding.
licenseUI.feature.BASIC_ROUTING.benefit1: Flexible path matching (exact, prefix and regex)
licenseUI.feature.BASIC_ROUTING.benefit2: Request method filtering (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, etc.)
licenseUI.feature.BASIC_ROUTING.useCase1: API path normalization (e.g. forwarding /api/v1/* to a backend service)
licenseUI.feature.BASIC_ROUTING.useCase2: A single managed entry point for microservices
licenseUI.feature.LOCAL_RATE_LIMIT.name: Local rate limiting
licenseUI.feature.LOCAL_RATE_LIMIT.desc: In-memory rate limiting for a single instance, by QPS or concurrency
licenseUI.feature.LOCAL_RATE_LIMIT.detai: Local rate limiting runs in process memory and suits single-instance deployments. It supports both QPS (requests per second) and concurrency limits to prevent service overload.
licenseUI.feature.LOCAL_RATE_LIMIT.benef: QPS limiting: cap the maximum requests per second
Concurrency limiting: cap the requests processed at once
Limit by IP, user, path and other dimensions
licenseUI.feature.LOCAL_RATE_LIMIT.useCa: Shield backend services from traffic spikes
licenseUI.feature.BASIC_AUTH.name: Basic authentication
licenseUI.feature.BASIC_AUTH.detail: Basic authentication provides API key verification with per-route configuration - simple to use and well suited to internal service calls.
licenseUI.feature.BASIC_AUTH.benefit1: API key authentication: simple and suited to internal service calls
licenseUI.feature.BASIC_AUTH.benefit2: Per-route configuration: different routes can use different methods
licenseUI.feature.BASIC_AUTH.benefit3: Returns HTTP 401 automatically on authentication failure
licenseUI.feature.DOCKER_DEPLOY.name: Docker deployment
licenseUI.feature.DOCKER_DEPLOY.desc: Containerized deployment and management with Docker
licenseUI.feature.DOCKER_DEPLOY.detail: Docker deployment runs the gateway in containers and provides basic container management for fast rollout and operations.
licenseUI.feature.HEALTH_CHECK.name: Health checks
licenseUI.feature.HEALTH_CHECK.desc: Detect unhealthy service instances and remove them automatically
licenseUI.feature.HEALTH_CHECK.detail: Health checks probe backend instances periodically, eject unhealthy ones and re-add them after recovery to keep services highly available.
licenseUI.feature.HEALTH_CHECK.benefit2: Passive detection based on request failure rate
licenseUI.feature.HEALTH_CHECK.useCase1: Automatic detection of failing microservice instances
licenseUI.feature.SERVICE_DISCOVERY.name: Service discovery
licenseUI.feature.SERVICE_DISCOVERY.deta: Service discovery supports both static configuration and DNS, so backend addresses can be resolved dynamically from different service registries.
licenseUI.feature.SERVICE_DISCOVERY.bene: Static configuration: specify service addresses manually
DNS discovery: resolve service domains automatically
licenseUI.feature.TIMEOUT_CONFIG.name: Timeout configuration
licenseUI.feature.TIMEOUT_CONFIG.desc: Basic request and connection timeout control
licenseUI.feature.TIMEOUT_CONFIG.detail: Timeout configuration covers connect, read and write timeouts, with per-route values to prevent requests from blocking for too long.
licenseUI.feature.TIMEOUT_CONFIG.useCase: Prevent resources from being held too long
licenseUI.feature.BASIC_LOGGING.name: Logging
licenseUI.feature.BASIC_LOGGING.desc: Record and query request and error logs
licenseUI.feature.BASIC_LOGGING.detail: Logging covers the full request lifecycle - ingress, routing decisions, backend calls and responses - for troubleshooting and audit trails.
licenseUI.feature.BASIC_LOGGING.benefit2: Automatic capture and classification of errors
licenseUI.feature.BASIC_METRICS.name: Basic metrics
licenseUI.feature.BASIC_METRICS.desc: Request volume, success rate and response time metrics
licenseUI.feature.BASIC_METRICS.detail: Basic metrics collects and displays core performance data - request volume, success rate and response time - with Grafana visualization integration.
licenseUI.feature.BASIC_METRICS.benefit1: Real-time request volume (QPS and total requests)
licenseUI.feature.WEIGHTED_ROUTING.name: Weighted multi-service routing
licenseUI.feature.WEIGHTED_ROUTING.desc: Route traffic across service instances by weight
licenseUI.feature.WEIGHTED_ROUTING.detai: Weighted routing splits traffic across backend services by weight, enabling traffic shaping, A/B testing and canary releases.
licenseUI.feature.DISTRIBUTED_RATE_LIMIT: Redis-backed global rate limiting across instances
Distributed rate limiting uses Redis so multiple gateway instances throttle together, keeping global QPS control accurate and consistent.
licenseUI.feature.CIRCUIT_BREAKER.name: Circuit breaker
licenseUI.feature.CIRCUIT_BREAKER.detail: The circuit breaker tracks service error rates, opens at the configured threshold to stop calls to failing services, and supports custom fallback responses.
licenseUI.feature.K8S_INTEGRATION.name: Kubernetes integration
licenseUI.feature.K8S_INTEGRATION.desc: K8s cluster management, Pod deployment and autoscaling
licenseUI.feature.K8S_INTEGRATION.detail: Kubernetes integration provides full cluster management, including Deployment management, Pod monitoring and HPA autoscaling.
Prometheus integration provides complete metric collection and alerting, with custom metrics and multi-dimensional aggregation.
licenseUI.feature.JWT_AUTH.name: JWT authentication
licenseUI.feature.JWT_AUTH.desc: Stateless JWT authentication with custom claims
licenseUI.feature.JWT_AUTH.detail: JWT authentication is stateless and supports custom claims, token refresh and revocation lists.
licenseUI.feature.HMAC_AUTH.name: HMAC signature authentication
licenseUI.feature.HMAC_AUTH.detail: HMAC signature authentication verifies request signatures with high security, preventing tampering and replay attacks.
licenseUI.feature.GRAY_RELEASE_BASIC.det: Basic canary release splits traffic by percentage to roll out new versions gradually.
licenseUI.feature.ADVANCED_AUDIT.name: Advanced audit
licenseUI.feature.ADVANCED_AUDIT.desc: Configuration change timeline and exportable reports
licenseUI.feature.ADVANCED_AUDIT.detail: Advanced audit records a complete timeline of configuration changes for traceability, operation auditing and compliance checks, with exportable analysis reports.
licenseUI.feature.ADVANCED_AUDIT.benefit: Traceability of operator, time and content
licenseUI.feature.FULL_GRAY_RELEASE.name: Full canary release
licenseUI.feature.FULL_GRAY_RELEASE.desc: Multi-dimensional canary rules on headers, params and cookies
licenseUI.feature.FULL_GRAY_RELEASE.deta: Full canary release supports rules based on headers, query parameters, cookies and user IDs for precise canary traffic control.
licenseUI.feature.FULL_GRAY_RELEASE.bene: User ID and percentage canary rules
licenseUI.feature.AI_COPilot.name: AI Copilot
licenseUI.feature.AI_COPilot.desc: AI assistant for route configuration generation and error analysis
licenseUI.feature.AI_COPilot.detail: AI Copilot integrates large language models to generate route configurations, analyze error logs and suggest performance diagnostics.
licenseUI.feature.AI_COPilot.benefit1: Generate route configuration from natural language
licenseUI.feature.STRESS_TEST.name: One-click load testing
licenseUI.feature.STRESS_TEST.desc: Built-in load testing with bottleneck analysis
licenseUI.feature.STRESS_TEST.detail: One-click load testing provides a built-in performance tool that launches load tests quickly, analyzes bottlenecks automatically and generates test reports.
licenseUI.feature.MULTI_TENANT.name: Multi-tenant isolation
licenseUI.feature.MULTI_TENANT.desc: Tenant-level configuration isolation and access control
licenseUI.feature.MULTI_TENANT.detail: Multi-tenant isolation separates configuration, routes, authentication and other resources per tenant, each managed independently without interference.
licenseUI.feature.FULL_CHAIN_TRACE.name: Full-chain tracing
licenseUI.feature.FULL_CHAIN_TRACE.desc: End-to-end request tracing and performance analysis
licenseUI.feature.FULL_CHAIN_TRACE.detai: Full-chain tracing visualizes the entire request lifecycle from ingress to backend calls, making it easier to locate performance bottlenecks and troubleshoot failures.
licenseUI.feature.OAUTH2_AUTH.name: OAuth2 authentication
licenseUI.feature.OAUTH2_AUTH.detail: OAuth2 authentication follows the standard OAuth2 protocol and integrates third-party identity providers for enterprise-wide unified authentication.
licenseUI.feature.SSL_MANAGEMENT.name: SSL certificate management
licenseUI.feature.SSL_MANAGEMENT.detail: SSL certificate management centralizes certificates and provides automatic renewal and expiry reminders to keep HTTPS services secure.
